in_marathi.name: Mahadeb
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahadeb हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahadev or Mahadevah is a revered name derived from Sanskrit language. It signifies a great god or the supreme god in Hindu mythology. The name is associated with power, strength, and divinity. In Hindu scriptures, Mahadev is often depicted as the lord of the universe, creator of the cosmos, and the destroyer of evil.
